summary: Frontend-only validation of redesigned Vertex AI landing page (/app/components/vertex-landing.tsx). Verified hero, navbar (desktop + mobile hamburger + auto-close on link click), features bento (all 6 cards), how-it-works (3 timeline steps), pricing (Free + License cards with all buttons/hrefs/targets), CTA band, footer (privacy/support). Checked hrefs & external target=_blank on Telegram/Quotex links. Anchor smooth-scroll works (scrollY=1031 after Features click). No console/page errors. No horizontal overflow at 390px, 768px, or 1920px. All expected data-testids present and visible.
critical_code_review_comments: vertex-landing.tsx is 856 lines — consider splitting into subcomponents (Navbar, Hero, Features, Pricing, Footer) per file for maintainability, though not blocking.
NAV_LINKS is used both by Navbar and Footer.slice(0,3) — fine, but the Support link (external Telegram) is skipped in the footer's Explore section by design; intentional and correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static Next.js frontend on port 3000, no backend. All data-testids listed in review_request verified present and functional. Mobile menu closes after clicking any link (behavior confirmed via nav-mobile-menu visibility check post-click).
